content: We thank Phil Blunsom for initial discussions which seeded many of the core ideas in the present work. We also thank Yonatan Belinkov and Shay Cohen for helpful feedback, and Andrew Drozdov for providing the parsed dataset from their DIORA model. YK is supported by a Google Fellowship. AMR acknowledges the support of NSF 1704834, 1845664, AWS, and Oracle.
